title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE missing require_fips for UNSET fd
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info.require_fips is only populated in the CRYPTO2DEV_FDTYPE_OPERATION branch of ioctl_get_state (crypto2dev_fd.c:1421). After CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS is called on an UNSET fd, GET_STATE returns require_fips==0 — the UNSET default: branch sets nothing. A debugger or test harness cannot observe whether REQUIRE_FIPS was called on an fd that has not yet been promoted to OPERATION. This is an observability gap: if a future ABI revision adds require_fips semantics to KEY fds (which is plausible), the current GET_STATE output for an UNSET fd is already misleading and cannot be distinguished from the no-REQUIRE_FIPS case without the fix.
